title: Opening and Fred Minor's birth
summary: Date, place and names for the recording; Minor gives his name, nickname and birth in 1913 on Perdido Street.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I want to make a note that the date is November 1st in All Saints Day in 1961 and we're over at 1109 South Galvez interviewing Mr. Fred Miner. Do you mind giving me your full name and also your nickname? How do you spell it?
Frederick C. Miner is my correct name. My nickname everybody call me H. A-C-H-I-E.
I used to say it was just like H, the letter H. That's what I thought it was, just like the letter H.
Do you mind telling just when you were born? I was born in 1913, December the 8th. What part of town? Right here in New Orleans? Right here in New Orleans on Perdita Street.
Perdita right there, not so far from this section here I guess. That's right, not too far.
Perdita what? Perdita between Roman and Bolivar.
